# Tolland depot takes pallets until 16:00

## Context Scope

Same-day drop-offs at Tolland's depot.

## Fact Statement

Tolland's depot takes pallets until 16:00 for next-morning delivery.

## Why This Matters

Superseded when the depot moved its cutoff to 17:00. Nothing in this record is current.
